text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole weeks. Dashed line: the 0.5 the plan required. D5 and D9 are the targets, D10 and D16 are placebos. Rows of the first five groups: the quarter of April-to-June daylight half-hours where arm D trails BG2 most. Last group: every daylight half-hour. Larger is a bigger share removed.'
